The Academic Accelerator Program (AAP) is a two-semester program designed specifically for students who are ready to succeed in immersive English-speaking classrooms, but who also want the benefit of English-language and student support to help them thrive. The program curriculum offers a balance of university-wide and AAP-exclusive courses, with English-language course supplements that equip students with the practical, subject-specific vocabulary and skills they need to excel in their coursework. Students may enter the program in the spring, summer or fall. Upon completion of the program, students progress into the second year of their undergraduate education with a full year’s worth of academic credits.

The Bachelor of Science in Communication Disorders provides pre-professional training in speech-language pathology and audiology within a strong liberal arts framework. The program is designed to prepare students for graduate school in speech-language pathology, audiology, and speech and hearing science. In addition to preparing students for graduate education in audiology and speech-language pathology, a bachelor’s degree in communication disorders can lead to careers in a variety of other fields such as health care, education, science and public policy.

The Bachelor of Science in Information Systems (IS) program enables students to develop the technical skills needed in the modern workplace. Through a wide selection of technology offerings and courses offered in cooperation with Adelphi’s School of Business, the IS program blends theory and hands-on application to prepare students for careers in the exciting fields of software systems development, network and security administration, database management, systems analysis, and ecommerce. Optional concentrations offer students in-depth training in game development or information security.

The Advanced Master’s Accelerator Program (Advanced MAP) is a one-semester, pre-master’s program designed specifically for international students who are ready to succeed in immersive English-speaking classrooms, but who also want the benefit of English-language and academic training that will help them succeed in their postgraduate program. The program curriculum offers a balance of degree-specific and MAP-exclusive courses. Students will be equipped with the practical, degree-specific vocabulary and research skills they need to excel in their coursework.

A Master’s of Computer Science enhances students’ ability to enter into a cutting-edge field with the technical and professional skills they need to stand out in the competitive job market. With a focus on research and industry-leading trends, students are equipped with the necessary tools for a successful career in the digital space.

To enhance students' area of expertise, the M.S. in Computer Science program offers two areas of specialization:

  • Cybersecurity
  • Software Engineering
